quest.title: Meow... Meow meow? Meow! Meow.
quest.description: Sareh seems to be concerned about her cats...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I've spoken to cats before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean Neko? But she can speak our language. That doesn't really count as "cat-talk"...

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Indeed. Still, in exchange, you will need to help me find a cat.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: So you agree? Why, thank you so much!

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: Ahem... Now, listen carefully. This is the outline of cat language that I've been working on for a long time.

choices.text: Looks like each city has its unique way of looking for cats...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, that's true! If you think about it, we've helped people find cats in quite a few cities by now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should we say that everyone just loves cats, or that everyone who owns a cat has the same problem?

talks.objective: Confirm the cat's message with Sareh

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Thank you very much, Traveler. I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: I hope that your talk with the cat goes well.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: The one that has slipped out today is a black and white cat called "Lale."

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: In cat language, you should call for it like this... "Meow, meow meow meow, meeeeow!"

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Keep in mind how the tone falls and then rises again. Make sure that the last "meow" is very high.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me write a note for you. Please wait just a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: The one that has slipped out for snacks today is a dark gray cat called "Nargis."

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: In cat language, you should call for it like this... "Meow! Meow meow, meow."

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Remember to stress the first meow and say the following ones quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let me write a note for you. Wait just a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: The one that has slipped out for a date today is a gray and black striped cat called "Rozan."

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: In cat language, you would call for it by saying... "Meow meow meow, meow meow meow."

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Both sets of meows are quick sounds, so make sure you don't drawl.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Actually... Let me write a note for you. Wait just a moment, will you?

dialogues.text: Meow... meow meow?

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Oh, you brought the kitten back. Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Well, it looks like you are doing pretty well with cat-talk.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Here, please take this as compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: There aren't many people who can pick up cat language this fast. You know... I could even use your help in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you can speak normally. Ms. Sareh is not a cat!

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: I can see from your face that you were trying to say "my pleasure," but your pronunciation still has room for improvement, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: It's okay though. I'll keep teaching you about cat language. We'll learn together!

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Meow— *cough*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, what are you doing...?

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: I'm looking for my kittens. Normally, they respond to my call.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Is my pronunciation off today somehow? I've been calling them for ages, and none of them have answered. How strange...

choices.text: Can't you just call their names?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Don't people usually call kittens' names when looking for them, right?

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: But if you call for them in our language, they can't understand it, can they?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Well, you do have a point there...

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: Still, I'm getting nowhere shouting myself hoarse like this.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: Traveler, I'd like to ask you a serious question.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: ...Would you like to learn the language of cats?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean you're gonna teach us how to talk to cats?

choices.text: What did you mean by "your pronunciation today" being off, anyway?

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: Well, I was calling their names, actually, just in the language of cats.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: After all, they wouldn't necessarily understand if we called them in our language, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Well, you do have a point there...

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Indeed. But in exchange, you need to help me find a cat.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: So you agree? Why, thank you so much!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, that's true! If you think about it, we've helped people find cats in quite a few cities by now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should we say that everyone just loves cats, or that everyone who owns a cat has the same problem?

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Eh? You didn't find the cat?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Sareh what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Is that so? Well, it's okay. Cat language is not easy for beginners, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: I'll go find them myself later. Still, thank you for the trouble. Please take these as your payment, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Sareh
dialogues.text: Do you have any further questions, Traveler?

choices.text: Could you help me with the cat's name in their language...

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: That's on the note I wrote for you. Please refer to it if your memory fails you.

choices.text: You don't seem too worried about them.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: Well, people in town love the cats. They often play with them and feed them.

response.speaker: Sareh
response.text: I'm just hoping that they don't eat too much and get overweight.
